lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal Sr4Ag2Pd2O10 structure (Sr2AgPdO5) crystallizes in space group I-4m2 (No. 119) with 18 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Pd each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors, while Sr is eight-coordinate to O and O centers are three- or four-coordinate. Corner-sharing is observed between Ag and Pd tetrahedra and between Sr polyhedra, with additional corner, edge, and face contacts among the Sr polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
